average_burn.description: The average net burn of the first 12 months.

break_even.description: The first month with revenue whose EBITDA is not negative (YYYY-MM); absent: not within the forecast.

buffer_months.description: The buffer the gap used: the scenario's, the forecast's or planning.buffer_months.

cash_out_month.description: The first month cash closes below zero (YYYY-MM); absent: not within the horizon.

customers_end.description: Customers at the horizon, to 1 decimal.

funding_gap.description: The buffer × the average burn, less the minimum cash, at least 0.

revenue_next_12.description: The revenue of the next 12 months.

runway_beyond.description: true: no cash-out month within the horizon, so runway is more than runway_months.

runway_months.description: The months before the cash-out month; the horizon when there is none, with runway_beyond.
